title: Awrad practice settings v1
description: The account practice policy (synced as the practice_policy entity of the change queue) and the device context (never leaves the device). See README.md and the root ADR on practice settings (slice 3d).

day_reset.description: When the effective practice day changes: at local midnight, or at Maghrib (falling back to midnight without a known Maghrib). CONTEXT.md, Effective practice day.

calculation_method.description: Prayer-time calculation method, by the adhan library's names. Only dubai and moonsighting_committee move Maghrib (3 minutes after sunset); the others only change Fajr, Isha or Dhuhr.

madhab.description: The Asr shadow rule: shafi (Shafi'i, Maliki, Hanbali: shadow length 1) or hanafi (2).

practice_policy_document.description: The account practice policy, one per account: the practice_policy entity, whose entity_id is the account ID. Every member is always present. hijri_corrections is a valid set (urn:awrad:hijri-calendar:1#/$defs/corrections, fixtures/hijri_corrections_validity.json in hijri-calendar/v1): clients write it sorted by year, then month; the server accepts any order and stores it as sent. Rules the schema can't express (duplicate months, month lengths): fixtures/practice_policy_validity.json.

default_policy.description: The policy of a new local profile, and the base a phone or the web merges against when it knows no server copy (the frozen defaults).

location.description: Where this device is, for Maghrib. Kept only on the device (phones: per installation, shared by its profiles; web: per account in that browser) and never sent to the server. name is what Settings shows: the city's name for a city, the place's name from the platform search, or null for GPS. city_id is the bundled city (urn:awrad:places:1) when source is city, else null.
